gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: All 60 local episodes used four grayscale frames and produced zero invalid actions, but no exact ZIP or official server check was performed for these four wrappers.

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: Across twelve fresh tune cells, action changes were 275 curve approach, 121 edge closure, 65 lateral drift, and 149 obstacle closing. This establishes behavior change, not safety benefit.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: The stable-risk control finished 12/12. Candidate finishes were 10/12 curve approach, 10/12 edge closure, 10/12 lateral drift, and 11/12 obstacle closing. Completion-first selection rejects all four regardless of finished-lap times.
